core_struggle: A man who feels his wife's arguments undermine his authority wants verses to prove she must obey him.
mirror: You keep going over the same argument, and you want scripture to settle it in your favour.

queries.hook: My partner and I keep fighting. Inside, I keep going over it again and again, and I don't know how to carry it.
queries.diagnose: When your worth depends on being obeyed, every word of disagreement shakes you; the need to prove it with scripture is the mind caught in its own pride.
queries.steady: Praise and blame, agreement and disagreement come and go; the self is not shaken by the voice of the one it loves.
queries.act: See the argument as the ego speaking, not as her failing; practise listening to the part of you that wants to be right, and let it be the one to step back first.
queries.story: A king who wanted his wife to agree with him, and learned that the one who must be obeyed is the one who cannot hear another voice.

bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call needing their approval, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: Over seven days the need to be obeyed is named, and the one who wants to be right is invited to step back.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the frustration of being questioned, and the need to have the last word.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the need to be obeyed is the root of the pain, not her arguments.
week_beats.steady: You hold that your worth is not measured by her obedience.
week_beats.act: You try listening to the part of you that wants to be right, and let it step back first.
week_beats.story: A king who wanted his wife to agree with him shows you what it means to step back from the need to be obeyed.

insight: What weighs on you is waiting for someone else to tell you the work was enough.
